title: Build a Multimodal Causal Attention Mask
summary: Putting sensors into a language sequence must not let a prediction read future tokens.

frames: Declared normalized action/feature coordinates; no implicit frame conversion

units.values: All axes are token positions and dimensionless modality identifiers; no actuator units.

physical_contract.timestamp_assumptions: Sequence order defines causality. Tokens may describe multiple sensors but callers must synchronize them before this function.

provenance.authoring_notes: Original dense causal-mask component for a PaLM-E-style interleaved sequence. This declares ordinary autoregressive causality, not bidirectional vision blocks or a full model attention implementation.
